title: motorcycle, bmw, engine rev, underground, garage
author: golovlev.sound
changes: A real BMW motorbike revving its engine twice, 'vroom… vroom!', in an echoey underground car park. Trimmed to 0.00–2.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.4 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 70 Hz high-pass trims the car park's measured low hum.
